author: bardic-inspiration
name: Orc Ravager
summary: A berserk orc who fights harder the closer it comes to death.
description: Ravagers are what is left when the clan's anger is given a body and a weapon. They go into a fight as if they had already lost, and nobody who has watched one will argue.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.text: At the start of its turn, the ravager can gain {ref:glossary/advantage} on all melee attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have Advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.text: If the ravager is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, it drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The ravager makes two Greataxe attacks.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive
bonusActions.text: The ravager moves up to its Speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
